Hi! Regarding SLOTPLAN-106: The design review decision for parse_range was that ranges where end < start (night shifts) should have 1440 added to the end value. So '22:00-06:00' parses as (1320, 1800). Hope that helps!

Hi @eng-50! For rotate_rota: it was agreed that the desk is closed at weekends (Saturdays and Sundays, weekdays 5 and 6). These days should get an empty list and not use up anyone's turn; the next working day continues where Friday left off.

Hi! Regarding SLOTPLAN-118: the design review decision was that a dropped occurrence still consumes one of the `count` slots (similar to an excluded date in a calendar series). The series is not extended to make up for dropped occurrences, so the result can be shorter than `count`.
